prompt: Create an original 60 second Chinese plucked-string ensemble instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: pipa, yangqin, dizi, frame drum. Style: crisp plucked ostinato with bright bamboo-flute answers. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and traditional East Asian instrumental piece featuring a plucked zither (Guzheng) and a melodic flute, creating a peaceful and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静的东方传统器乐曲，以弹拨古筝和悠扬的笛子为主，营造出平和而富有沉思感的氛围。
